messages.subject: Scheduled DMS maintenance - Saturday 17 January
messages.plaintextBody:
The document management system will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 17 January until approximately 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please save and close all documents beforehand. Email will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
